sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: Meccanica C has no approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL. The record is the complete list, and its BR-180 approval does not carry over to another part. A supplier audit does not grant a part approval. PRC-DEV-007 also says a temporary deviation does not approve a new material source.

sources.quote: BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
Rev B is superseded and withdrawn as of 2026-06-01.

findings.why: Drawing Rev C, which is in force, requires EN AW-6082-T6 for BR-220. Meccanica C quoted EN AW-6061-T6, which is a different grade. The supplier's claim of equivalent strength does not replace the grade the drawing specifies. The email's note that 6061-T6 is acceptable for BR-220 is not a controlled drawing or record, and it conflicts with Rev C.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The only support for 6061-T6 being equivalent to 6082 is the supplier's statement and an email figure. No material certificate or test result for Meccanica C's billet is in the documents. A person must supply one before anyone can judge capability against the drawing.
